description: Cookieless edge analytics for a hosted site: pageviews, 404s, top pages, referrers, and countries. Off by default. Enable with update_project_settings analytics_enabled=true. Default last 7 days (max 90). If disabled, returns enabled=false and empty totals.

from.description: Inclusive start date (ISO). Optional; default 7 days ago.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

to.description: Inclusive end date (ISO). Optional; default today. Range max 90 days.

name: get_project_analytics
title: Get project analytics
